# Ammar Academy (أكاديمية عمار)

> Ammar Academy is an online test-prep academy in Egypt for the SAT, EST, ACT and IELTS. It serves American Diploma students (grades 10–12) and their parents, and IELTS candidates, with live Zoom classes, recorded lessons, weekly study plans, full mock tests, weekly progress reports for parents and personal follow-up. Teaching is in Egyptian Arabic and English. Last updated: 2026-11-25.

- Website: https://ammar-academy.com/
- Phone: +20 108 054 8078 (01080548078)
- WhatsApp: +20 103 193 7388 (01031937388)
- Office: 63 ج، البوابة الأولى، حدايق الأهرام، الجيزة 12562، مصر (63G, Gate 1, Hadayek El Ahram, Giza 12562, Egypt). Open 11:00–19:00 every day except Friday.
- Social: [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/ammar.academy), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ammar.academy/), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@Ammar-Academy), [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@ammar.sat.academy)

## Courses

- [SAT courses](https://ammar-academy.com/sat/): live Zoom classes with recordings, homework, regular mock tests and a weekly report for parents. Full package (English + Math), 46 sessions: 11,900 EGP. English only, 22 sessions: 7,500 EGP. Math only, 24 sessions: 8,000 EGP. Advanced English or Advanced Math, 12 sessions each: 3,900 EGP. Next group starts 26 December 2026. A free trial session is available.
- [IELTS course](https://ammar-academy.com/ielts/): 6 weeks, 30 sessions in total (18 live Zoom sessions, 6 recorded sessions, 5 full mock tests and 1 orientation session), with private Writing and Speaking correction: 3,900 EGP. Private one-to-one course, 8 sessions: 5,900 EGP. Next round starts 5 December 2026. A free trial session is available.
- Students' results include SAT scores of 1510, 1440 and 1420 out of 1600, and IELTS band 8.0.

## Guides (Arabic)

- [SAT vs EST vs ACT](https://ammar-academy.com/sat-vs-est/): how the three exams differ, which Egyptian universities accept them, and how American Diploma students should choose.
- [SAT scores 2026](https://ammar-academy.com/sat-score/): how the SAT is scored out of 1600, the passing score cited by Egyptian universities, what counts as a good score, and upcoming test dates.
- [How to choose an SAT course in Egypt](https://ammar-academy.com/sat-course-egypt/): eight questions to ask any SAT course before paying, plus Ammar Academy's course details and prices.
- [IELTS band scores explained](https://ammar-academy.com/ielts-band-score/): what each band means, how the overall band is rounded, and how many correct answers give each band in Listening and Reading.

## Free tools

- [DSAT Vocabulary Challenge](https://ammar-academy.com/vocabulary/): a free interactive game for about 500 essential Digital SAT words.
